SERVICES.HEAD: SERVICES
SERVICES.BUILDINGDESIGNTEXT: The process of designing a building unfolds through several stages, each involving the preparation of a specific set of project documentation. In line with this, we offer the development of the following documentation packages:
SERVICES.PROJECTLEGALIZATIONTEXT:
The procedure and method of legalizing buildings, or parts of buildings, constructed without a building permit or approval.

Technical documentation required for the legalization process includes:
  • Report on the current condition of the building
  • Geodetic survey study
SERVICES.ENERGYEFFICENCYTEXT: Energy efficiency encompasses a set of measures we take to reduce energy consumption. An Energy Efficiency Study is an essential component in the process of obtaining a building permit.

Q1.ANSWER1: The conceptual design represents the basic concept of the building, prepared for the purpose of obtaining location conditions. It contains key data required to verify compliance with the planning document and to define the conditions for further design and infrastructural connections – such as purpose, gross floor area, dimensions, regulation, plot positioning, access, number of units, and methods of connection to the utility network.

Q2.ANSWER2: The preliminary design defines the purpose, form, capacity, and technical characteristics of the building, with a demonstration of compliance with location requirements and planning documents. It is prepared for the purpose of feasibility studies and obtaining approval for construction works, in accordance with the Law on Planning and Construction.

Q3.ANSWER3: The building permit project defines the purpose, form, capacity, and technical characteristics of the building, with a demonstration of compliance with location requirements and planning documents. It is prepared for the purpose of feasibility studies and obtaining approval for construction works, in accordance with the Law on Planning and Construction.

Q4.ANSWER4: The building permit project is a set of coordinated designs that define the position, capacity, structure, installations, and equipment of the building, in accordance with location conditions and applicable regulations. It elaborates on the concept from the initial design, ensuring alignment of key parameters such as purpose, gross floor area, regulation, positioning, and infrastructural connections.

Q5.ANSWER5: The as-built design is prepared for the purpose of obtaining an occupancy permit. It represents a set of coordinated projects that display all details of the constructed building necessary to verify its suitability for use.
